note: Bar & grill with an attached 21-site RV campground on US-53 in Ray: gravel sites on open ground with little shade, and trains can be heard. Sites 1-14 fit big rigs. The park has no web page of its own, only Facebook, so its rate is camper-reported (July and August 2026 RV Life reviews). --Claude
